body.title: Blocked in M-5: a task of M-5
body.body:
Recommended: Close mission M-5 — started 30 hours ago, used 15× its 2 hours, nothing has run

Task t_01M5FYMA9YBAY9RKQ928TA26KJ (implement, bifrost-platform) of mission M-5 is blocked; card 1 for this block.

Title: a task of M-5

Why: mission M-5 is past its 2 hours (it started 30.0 hours ago): no host may take this task until the budget grows

Give it one more round: it goes back to ready as it is, and a host takes it as usual. One round needs up to 3 attempts (implementation, verification, review); mission M-5 has used 0 of its 9 attempts and 30.0 of its 2 hours, so this answer also raises its budget to 34 hours, recorded with this card's answer.
Do not do this task: the task is cancelled; mission M-5 finishes once every other task is accepted (a task that depends on this one is then blocked and gets a card of its own).
Close mission M-5: every task of mission M-5 that has not ended is cancelled (an attempt still running is stopped), its other open cards are withdrawn, and it ends: done when an implementation of it was accepted, else stopped.

options.label: Close mission M-5
options.detail: started 30 hours ago, used 15× its 2 hours, nothing has run

body.urgency: when you can: only this task waits for you, and its mission cannot finish without your answer
body.meanwhile: the task stays blocked and mission M-5 stays open

From WORK.md, 第 2 轮逐项, lines 14-39, checked at 2026-10-19 01:20.

body.title: Import recorder log td-901: retire the recorder
body.body:
thread:buttons proposes to import the recorder log of td-901, proposal 5be84ec82f9e.

Why: retire the recorder

2 events: 1 work_closed, 1 work_opened. The hash chain holds from the first line to the last.

From td-901/events.jsonl, sha256 847b5f3776999f9909feefc1299ecb20b1b7dd23b32714995f611e3a0474357e; kept log sha256:5293e0d371533663d0fc3c45bf5c29c62905453b043f816559016ebaba3b180a.
